name: Boseoksonyeo Ellejyu
source:
In Destiny Stone you must help Penelope Pearl save Nassaria from the evil God of Destruction! Explore the countryside, battle fierce enemies and make friends as you learn powerful jewel magic and uncover a deep and engaging storyline.

A game for Facebook. A visual novel as well as a sidescrolling RPG.
translation:
In Destiny Stone you must help Penelope Pearl save Nassaria from the evil God of Destruction! Explore the countryside, battle fierce enemies and make friends as you learn powerful jewel magic and uncover a deep and engaging storyline.

A game for Facebook. A visual novel as well as a sidescrolling RPG.
